admin.drawing.title: Drawing defaults
admin.drawing.intro: What a pilot's device draws with when nothing else asks: how the scan is drawn, how many splats at most, and how sharp (the share of the screen's pixels). The simulator recognises the class of each device from its browser and starts that class's preset; the pilot can name another class, or set Render and Splat budget by hand, in Settings, Display. Sorted is the classic, smooth drawing. Stochastic is SuperSplat's own sort-free renderer with a temporal history (v0.11): a camera at rest settles to 31 to 41 dB from the sorted picture within about 8 s, in flight it is 23 to 33 dB, at about half the sorted GPU time and, at 4K, 150 to 235 MB more video memory. The engine's own dither it replaced was 17 to 22 dB away and never settled.
admin.drawing.cannot: A phone, a tablet or a browser without WebGPU cannot draw stochastic: there the preset's drawing stays sorted whatever you choose here. A value you never touch follows the built-in table.
admin.drawing.resetAll: Reset every preset to the built-in table
admin.drawing.resetAll.confirm: Put every class back on the built-in values? It stays a draft until you press Publish.
admin.drawing.class.desktop-strong.what: WebGPU on a real adapter (NVIDIA, AMD, Apple, Intel Arc) with nothing weak about it.
admin.drawing.class.desktop-weak.what: No WebGPU, a software adapter, an Intel integrated GPU, or two of: at most 4 GB of memory, at most 4 processor cores, small GPU buffers.
admin.drawing.class.tablet.what: An iPad (also iPadOS), an Android tablet, any other handheld with a bigger screen.
admin.drawing.class.phone.what: An iPhone, an iPod, an Android phone, any handheld with less than 600 px on the short side of its screen.
admin.drawing.order.title: Who decides, in this order
admin.drawing.order.1: The scene's link: superspl.at/scene/<id>?budget=8&stochastic, or this site's own deep link.
admin.drawing.order.2: The pilot's own settings: Render, Splat budget and Device class (Settings, Display).
admin.drawing.order.3: The scene's own entry: the table below, or the scene's editor in the Scenes tab.
admin.drawing.order.4: The preset of the device's class: the table above, else the built-in one.
admin.drawing.scenes.title: Scene entries: {shown} of {n}
admin.drawing.scenes.help: A scene's own entry beats the device's preset and loses to the pilot's settings and the scene's link. Auto leaves the scene to the preset. The budget is in millions of splats (0.25 to 32); empty means the preset's.
